notes: SCToken (src/SCToken.sol) is the only contract in this launch; there are no application contracts. Its zero-argument constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 SC (1e27 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the launch factory, which performs the 10% swarm distribution, the 90% pool seed and forwards any remainder. Every transfer whose sender is the Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90) and whose recipient is not the PoolManager pays a 2% creator tax (200 bps, rounded down to minor units) to the constant wallet 0xD30eA9E0FA0C671BB4dC6C6e83863396B1822951; the PoolManager is debited the gross amount and the recipient receives the net amount. Transfers to the PoolManager (sells and the factory's pool seed) and ordinary wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed, so v4 settlement always balances. The tax rate, tax recipient and PoolManager address are compile-time constants. The token has no owner, admin, mint, burn, pause, blacklist or upgrade functions, and no delegatecall or selfdestruct. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, the total supply and the deployed currency order.
